column1: # clues.tsv for ft_putchar (rush) — hints only, never answers.
# (This test is unlabeled, so this single hint fires on any failure.)

ft_putchar receives one character and must put it on the screen with the only function this project allows. What does that function's manual page (man 2 write) say it needs to be told about the bytes you hand it, and does your call tell it all of that?
